SELECT T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.PROD_ID AS prodId, T1.PROD_NAME AS prodName, T1.SURFACE_IN_OUT AS surfaceInOut, T1.PROD_BRAND AS prodBrand, T1.PROD_STAGE AS prodStage, T1.RAISE_CCY AS raiseCcy, T1.RAISE_AMT_PLAN AS raiseAmtPlan, T1.TOTAL_AMT AS totalAmt, T1.SALE_AMT_STR AS saleAmtStr, T1.RAISE_VDATE AS raiseVdate, T1.RAISE_ENDDATE AS raiseEnddate, T1.CASH_PRIN_CCY AS cashPrinCcy, T1.CASH_PROF_CCY AS cashProfCcy, T1.VDATE AS vdate, T1.MDATE AS mdate, T1.LOW_YIELD AS lowYield, T1.HIGH_YIELD AS highYield, T1.IS_CONSTRACTE AS isConstracte, T1.RISK_LEVEL AS riskLevel, T1.PROD_MANAGE_PATTERN AS prodManagePattern, T1.CONT_MODE AS contMode, T1.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType, T1.PROD_SALEBANK_NAME AS prodSalebankName, T1.OPERATE_MODE AS operateMode, T1.CMMODE AS cmmode, T1.TERM_RIGHT_FLAG AS termRightFlag, T1.COOPERATION_NAME AS cooperationName, T1.INV_ASSET_TYPE AS invAssetType, T1.CUSTOMER_RISK_LEVEL AS customerRiskLevel, T1.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS customerType, T1.INVEST_ARAE AS investArae , T1.REMARK AS remark, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark , T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_FINANCE_PRODUCTS_SUB T1
1=1
and T1.DATE_STATUS BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(#{dateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY T1.STATUS_BATCH DESC

SELECT T1.REGIST_SEQNO AS registSeqno, T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.CUST_CONTRACT_NO AS custContractNo, T1.CUST_NAME AS custName, T1.ACCOUNT AS account, T1.FUND_ACC AS fundAcc, T1.FIN_ACC AS finAcc, T1.EQUITY_CONF_DATE AS equityConfDate, T1.CCY AS ccy, T1.SHARES AS shares, T1.AMOUNT AS amount, T1.AMOUNT_CNY AS amountCny, T1.FEE_AMT AS feeAmt, L1.ITEM_VALUE AS busiType, T1.CHANNEL AS channel, T1.BUSI_SEQNO AS busiSeqno, T1.ORG_ID AS orgId, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark, T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_PRODUCTS_DEAL_SUB T1 LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST L1 ON T1.BUSI_TYPE = L1.ITEM_CODE AND L1.DICT_CODE = 'SVR_BUSINESS_TYPE'
1=1
and T1.EQUITY_CONF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStatus}, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT T1.REGIST_SEQNO AS registSeqno, T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.ACCOUNT AS account, T1.INDENTIFY_MARK AS indentifyMark, T1.FUND_ACC AS fundAcc, T1.FIN_ACC AS finAcc, T1.AMOUNT_CNY AS amountCny, T1.IS_CONSIGN AS isConsign, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark, T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_PRODUCTS_BALANCE_SUB T1
1=1
and T1.DATE_STATUS BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(#{dateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.ASSET_ID AS assetId, T1.ASSET_NAME AS assetName, T1.INFORMATION_ASSETS_ID AS informationAssetsId, T1.ASSET_FLAG AS assetFlag, T1.FINANCIER_NAME AS financierName, T1.INDUSTRY_ID AS industryId, T1.CCY AS ccy, T1.HOLD_AMOUNT AS holdAmount, T1.ON_PASSAGE_AMT AS onPassageAmt, T1.HOLD_QTY_AMOUNT AS holdQtyAmount, T1.BONDSMAN AS bondsman, T1.FUNDS_USE_REMARK AS fundsUseRemark, T1.PAYMENT_REMARK AS paymentRemark, T1.ORG_ID AS orgId, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark, T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_ASSETS_ELEMENTS_SUB T1
1=1
and T1.DATE_STATUS BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(#{dateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.ACCOUNT AS account, T1.ASSET_ID AS assetId, T1.HOLD_QTY_AMOUNT AS holdQtyAmount, T1.HOLD_SHARES AS holdShares, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark, T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_PRODUCTS_ASSET_COMPARE T1
1=1
and T1.DATE_STATUS BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{dateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') and STR_TO_DATE(#{dateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
